subject: ggplot2 not rendering points or lines

messages.author: fa7e220e78bb8f46
messages.subject: ggplot2 not rendering points or lines
parts:
The attached .png is a screen shot of the problem.  The geom_point() is not rendering.  I honestly have no idea what the next step should be in debugging this.  I have tried updating packages in R.  I am left wondering if this is an issue with the OS; Ubuntu 11.04.

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

> is not rendering. I honestly have no idea what the next step should
> be in debugging this. I have tried updating packages in R. I am left
> wondering if this is an issue with the OS; Ubuntu 11.04.

Very often the problem with .png plots is the resolution. Try increasing
it. I have found res=200 to work pretty well.
